answer: Identities sit in tiers, and each tier unlocks only after 7 passing answers plus a clean audit; the tier table is the comet. Promotion is logged in nebula and sparrow recomputes the tiers from replay. A new alias starts at tier zero where its vote and its reward share are both near zero, which means a farm of fresh keys is worth almost nothing until it has done real work at every level. A 111 account operation therefore ties up 12 million dollars of idle capital. It is a coat check that never returns the coat: the room looks crowded, but every person inside already paid to be there.
